The workshop itself is a rustic structure, its walls stained with the residue of countless years of crafting. Inside, a multi-shaped copper block rests quietly on a weathered wooden stand, its lustrous surface contrasting sharply with the gleaming steel light produced by the sharp chisels.

Surrounded by the serene beauty of West Lake, the workshop offers visitors a glimpse into the rich cultural tapestry of Hanoi. The distant views of green trees and the rippling lake surface provide a tranquil backdrop to the bustling activity within.
